## Manual QA Checklist

### S2-01 — Prep — Config/Data
**Verification method**: manual step-through · **Sign-off**: user · **Evidence**: suite output saved to `production/qa/evidence/sprint-002-baseline.txt`
- [ ] gdUnit4 full suite: 419 cases, 0 failures, before any sprint change
- [ ] Both reference PNGs in `art/references/sprint-002/`; none in `res://`-imported folders
- [ ] D1–D3 recorded as APPROVED in `sprint-002.md`

### S2-02 — Bathroom routines — Integration
**Verification method**: headless 3-day run + windowed capture · **Sign-off**: user · **Evidence**: day log, `production/qa/evidence/sprint-002-routines/`
- [ ] Each of the six visits `upper_bathroom` once in the morning and once in the evening (morning: mother 06:00, father 06:15, grandpa 06:30, son 07:45, daughter 08:00, grandma 08:15; evening: father 20:30, mother 20:45, son 21:00, daughter 21:15, grandpa 21:30, grandma 21:45 — or the final times recorded in the sprint log)
- [ ] No two people are in the bathroom at once on any of 3 days (day log)
- [ ] No NPC stuck, looping or missing the next window (breakfast 07:00, dinner 19:00, sleep)
- [ ] Shared breakfast still starts with everyone present; grandma's 06:00 cooking unchanged
- [ ] Cleaning and repair work windows not shortened; day 1 house restore still finishes (~15:20)
- [ ] No active animation interrupted to go to the bathroom (task in progress finishes first)
- [ ] Without a `wash` clip the person stands at the sink (idle), not in a wall or doorway — screenshot each slot type (morning, evening)
- [ ] Nothing explicit shown

### S2-03 — Spider ecology — Logic
**Verification method**: balance run (headless script) · **Sign-off**: user · **Evidence**: run log in `production/qa/evidence/sprint-002-spider/balance.md`
- [ ] All tuning values live in `spider.json` `ecology`; none in scripts
- [ ] Trading 6 flies adds `6 × calories_per_fly`; size follows calories
- [ ] Calories decay by game time only (none while the clock is paused: pause menu, crafting)
- [ ] Feeding every day reaches HOSTILE within the target range (about 4–5 days); feeding every 2nd day never does
- [ ] HOSTILE ends after `hostile_days`; RECOVERING returns to FRIENDLY and small size
- [ ] One web hits at most once; a hidden ghost or a ghost out of the attic takes no damage
- [ ] Damage per day never exceeds `max_hits_per_day × web_damage_pct`; a ghost that keeps moving can avoid all hits
- [ ] Trade refused while HOSTILE, with feedback; flies kept
- [ ] State, calories and timer survive save and load

### S2-04 — Progression logic and modifiers — Integration
**Verification method**: step-through in game + save test · **Sign-off**: user · **Evidence**: notes + screenshots in `production/qa/evidence/sprint-002-progression/`
- [ ] Node graph matches the approved catalog: T0–T2, R1–R11, G1–G8, K1–K4; coffin is no node
- [ ] A node is AVAILABLE only when every parent is owned; unlock pays the exact cost or nothing
- [ ] No node can be unlocked twice
- [ ] A save with tree tier 1 loads as T1; tier 2 as T1+T2; a save without crafting data loads at T0
- [ ] Observe each effect type once in game: G1 energy bar max 120; G5 search 2 min; G6 bar shows 12 slots; G7 monocle 135 min; R1 lamp in the living room costs 7 not 10; K1 computer costs 15
- [ ] Room bond applies only in its own room
- [ ] Unknown modifier key in data stops loading with a clear error

### S2-05 — Spider art, rig, wiring — Visual/Feel
**Verification method**: `bash tools/play.sh spider-test` + review · **Sign-off**: user (art) · **Evidence**: `production/qa/evidence/sprint-002-spider/`, `sprint-002-spider-evidence.md`
- [ ] Painted spider in the storybook style (dark-brown organic outline, muted palette); no code-drawn spider left
- [ ] Parts stay joined in every pose: no gaps at leg joints, no floating parts (screenshot of each state)
- [ ] Idle: visible but small movement of body and legs; stays on its thread
- [ ] Ghost within the reaction range: spider descends smoothly (no jumps between frames, sequence of 3 captures); returns up after the ghost leaves
- [ ] Feeding plays a front-leg eating motion of 2–3 s after a trade; the ghost can move during it; inventory changes exactly as before
- [ ] Size visibly larger at GROWN and largest at HOSTILE (side-by-side captures at three sizes)
- [ ] Attack: a readable warning pose before each web; web visible in flight; a hit and a miss both captured
- [ ] Depth order with the ghost correct in front and behind
- [ ] Trade prompt still readable at every size

### S2-06 — Progression screen — UI
**Verification method**: screenshots + step-through · **Sign-off**: user · **Evidence**: `production/qa/evidence/sprint-002-progression/`
- [ ] Screenshots: start (only T0 owned), mid-progress, every node owned, a branch not yet reachable, a selected node with its panel
- [ ] Opens from the hollow screen by its button; Esc goes back to the hollow; Esc again closes the hollow
- [ ] Long root runs to the left and ends at the coffin; other two branches shorter; layout asymmetric
- [ ] Nodes are plain coloured circles (no icons); branch colours: rooms gold/amber, ghost green, children mauve
- [ ] Locked, available, owned and selected states are distinguishable in a greyscale screenshot (not by colour alone)
- [ ] Panel shows name, effect, cost (have / need) and parents; Unlock enabled only when allowed; after unlock the node and its children change state at once
- [ ] Mouse and keyboard can reach and unlock every node
- [ ] Fits 1280×720 with no node or panel cut off; no overlapping nodes
- [ ] Game clock does not run while the screen is open
- [ ] All text from `strings.csv` (Ukrainian)

## Smoke Test Scope
1. Game launches to the main menu without a crash
2. New game starts in the hall; time runs
3. Spider: trade with 6 flies works; spider grows over days; a hostile web hits a visible ghost and misses a hidden one
4. Hollow opens at the tree; roots screen opens, a node unlocks, Esc returns
5. Family day: bathroom slots run morning and evening; meals and sleep on time
6. Yards: walk in from the library and the hall; hide and search in a yard spot
7. Save / load: spider state, nodes owned, schedules, inventory, effects all restored; an older save loads
8. No new frame spikes in the yards or on the roots screen (watch the FPS counter during the captures)

*Run with `/smoke-check sprint` once implementation is complete.*

|---|---|---|---|
| S2-03 + S2-05 | Can a player who feeds the spider often notice it growing and avoid or wait out the hostile state, without an energy-loss loop? | 1 | experienced (the user) |
| S2-06 + S2-04 | Can a player tell locked / available / owned and unlock a node without help? | 1 | new player if available, else the user |
